apps.name: Dispatcher
apps.description: Schedule outbound pickups and inbound arrivals, track load progress, and view daily timelines.
apps.releaseNotes:
Dispatcher 1.1.6

- Shows the phone-security setup offer only once per account and server, including when Not now is selected or the dialog is dismissed.
- Keeps an existing phone-sign-in setup after password sign-in. It can still be enabled manually in Config.
- Tap an Outbounds SCAC badge to set a custom carrier using up to five uppercase letters. Clear restores the executing or assigned carrier.
- Saves the custom carrier for the load through the same MES update action used by the desktop app, without changing stop information.

mes-walkie-talkie 1.0.8

apps.name: Upkeep Beta
apps.description: Test reporting, repairs, parts approvals, preventive maintenance and inspections with mock data only.
apps.releaseNotes:
Upkeep 0.1.0-beta.10 - bold, minimal UI refinement

Reviewed with Impeccable using independent design and implementation assessments.
Purchase pages now use one primary footer action. Repeated PIN, report-progress, menu and photo-stack instructions have been reduced while required labels and consequences remain visible.
History opens with records; Search and Filters reveal controls on demand, with active filters visible and easy to clear.
Unfinished purchase inputs now survive rotation and returning to the form within the session. Invalid fields show local errors and focus the first correction. Purchase metadata is quieter; page headings expose native accessibility semantics.

Demo PIN: 1234. Sample data only. Photos and unfinished inputs remain session-only; closing the process or resetting the demo clears them.
